category_title: Students with learning disabilities who use abbreviations and pre-quizzes to prioritize lecture content
scenario_title: Note-taking during a 15-minute science video lecture
minimal_context: Noah is attempting to take notes on a blank piece of paper while watching a 15-minute video lecture on Electro-Plasma Rockets.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to watch this 15-minute video lecture on Electro-Plasma Rockets. Please take notes on the important points using your notebook paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He's talking really fast. I'm trying to write these bigger sentences but it takes too much time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep listening and write down what you hear.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know what the most important part of the topic is. I'm missing the clues about what I'm supposed to be paying attention to.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try your best to catch up and focus on the main ideas.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it. I'm writing too slow to understand the information from the lecture, and I have zero critical points written down so far.

task.content: Recording notes during a 15-minute video lecture on Electro-Plasma Rockets
task.learning_goal: Understand important points to store in long-term memory and apply fundamental scientific principles to postlecture quiz problems

context.materials: 15-minute video lecture, traditional note-taking materials, strategic note-taking (SN) paper with specific boxes, 10-point multiple-choice pre-lecture quiz

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Recording notes during a 15-minute video lecture on Electro-Plasma Rockets using traditional note-taking (pre-intervention)
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Poor note-taking, scoring 0 out of a possible 15 CLP in the initial assessment
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Struggling to manage temporal demands and identify significant points

behavior_patterns.condition: When trying to record notes during a lecture without strategy training
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Writes 'bigger sentences', fails to capture critical lecture points
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Struggles to understand information from the lectures and use memory effectively due to writing speed
related_quotes: I could write more, and I could write it in less time, ‘cause I would write bigger sentences smaller.
